verdict.rationale: The Turso Platform API manages databases, groups, organizations, and tokens programmatically, including per-user and per-agent provisioning and teardown. The official MCP server and CLI cover similar account management, so the core management surface is clearly scriptable. However, no source states that the API matches everything the dashboard can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec to verify coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of other dashboard areas (billing, members/invites, PITR/branch operations via the API), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
